summary.text: Software Engineer with a First-Class Honors degree in Information Technology and strong expertise in backend systems, full-stack web development, and DevOps automation. Open-source contributor to the Rust ecosystem (deadpool-rs) and creator of multiple developer tools, including a AWS Firecracker MicroVM Rust code execution server, a Rust LLDB MCP server, a PostgreSQL cluster setup and management tool, and an automated VPS deployment CLI. Proficient across Rust, Go, TypeScript, Python, and Java (Spring Boot), with hands-on experience in PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux infrastructure, and cloud administration.

highlights.text: Open-Source Contributions (deadpool-rs): Contributed merged pull requests to the deadpool. a Rust connection pool crate, resolving DevContainer startup failures, optimizing Docker build caching via .dockerignore and postCreateCommand restructuring (#477), and fixing macro visibility by exporting QueueMode in managed_reexports (#478).

Infrastructure & DevOps Tooling: Architected and open-sourced multiple systems tools in Rust and Go, including a declarative TOML-based VPS deployment CLI (crane), a PostgreSQL cluster supervisor (pgvisor), and a sandboxed Rust code execution server powered by AWS Firecracker MicroVMs.

Full-Stack System Architecture: Designed and built applications across Rust, Go, and Java Spring Boot, implementing background job workers, Stripe payment lifecycles (webhooks, refunds, cancellations), multi-role web dashboards, QR Code usage, and PDF report printing.
Technical Writing: Author and maintain thedreambook.github.io, an open-access engineering blog documenting systems programming, backend architecture, and DevOps practices.
Executed manual and automated quality assurance testing for a large-scale government web system using an internal Java and Selenium testing framework.
Documented software defects, tracked test coverage, and collaborated with engineering teams to ensure compliance with strict government project specifications.
Built a full-stack web application module using JavaServer Faces (JSF), PrimeFaces, and PostgreSQL under the direct mentorship of a Senior Software Engineer.

Workflow Automation: Automated bulk directory updates for the university website by surveying faculty via Google Forms and writing a Python script to programmatically generate and deploy HTML content.
Collaborated on redesigning the university's WordPress web portal to modernize the UI and improve navigation usability.
Provided hardware, network, and software troubleshooting for faculty workstations, printers, and university-wide events.
